messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PROD: kubelet NotReady flapping detected in inference-pool-usw2. ~12 nodes toggling. Pager -> @samira :rotating_light:
samira: on it, joining. any customer impact yet?
incident-bot: telemetry shows ~30% of requests to /v1/generate failing with connection reset / 504 from the load balancer. Elevated tail latency.
lee: digging into pod events — seeing repeated OOMKilled on gpu-runtime containers across multiple nodes. sample from `kubectl describe pod`:
```
Last State:     Terminated
  Reason:       OOMKilled
  Exit Code:    137
  Message:       "Killed process 2412 (runtime) total-vm:123456kB, anon-rss:987654kB"
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----    ------     ----  ----               -------
  Warning OOMKilling 2m    kubelet, node-45   Kill container with id docker://gpu-runtime: OOMKilled
```
alex: kubelet logs from node-45 show repeated restarts: `kubelet: failed to update node status, heartbeat missed` then `kubelet: starting` repeatedly. looks like ephemeral kubelet crash + restart loop.
nina: running `kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference -o wide` and `kubectl top nodes` — several nodes show memory pressure and one shows GPU reset count > 0. outputs:
```
NODE          STATUS   ROLES   AGE   MEMORY(%)   GPU-RESET
node-45-usw2  NotReady worker  12d   92%        3
node-47-usw2  Ready    worker  8d    78%        0
```
charlie: suggestion: cordon+drain the noisy nodes, scale the inference runtime by +3 replicas, and steer a small % of traffic to eu-west fallback while we triage.
samira: agree. charlie can you cordon/drain node-45 and node-49? I'll trigger scale and routing change.
charlie: running: `kubectl cordon node-45-usw2 && kubectl drain node-45-usw2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`
deploy-bot: Scale action: `deployment/inference-runtime` scaled from 40 -> 43 replicas (requested by samira).
charlie: drain started for node-45 — but kubelet restarted mid-drain, one pod got re-created on same node and hit OOM again.
nina: saw kernel logs on node-45: `dmesg` shows GPU reset and NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus, then oom_killer invoked. snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1e): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568000] Out of memory: Killed process 2412 (runtime) total-vm:...
```
lee: leaning towards driver/hardware fault rather than app-level leak — but pressure is high. I'm going to `ssh node-45` to capture `nvidia-smi -q` and full dmesg.
alex: temporary routing mitigation: bump `inference-routing:eu-west=20` so 20% of traffic goes to eu-west cold pool while we stable the us-west nodes. use flag `--route-config inference-routing:eu-west=20` in routing service.
samira: coordinating customer comms: no full outage but elevated errors for some customers. I’ll msg CSE + sentry: create short note for status page: "Partial degradation for inference-usw2, mitigations in progress."
charlie: adding taint to problematic nodes so autoscaler won't schedule while investigating: `kubectl taint nodes node-45-usw2 under-investigation=true:NoSchedule`
nina: taint applied on node-45/usw2 and node-49/usw2. preventing new pods.
lee: got `nvidia-smi -q` and full dmesg, uploading to incident bucket. looks consistent with GPU resets and memory pressure; I've opened a ticket with infra-hw for hardware review (serial-console + vendor).
samira: good. summary: cordon/drain applied, 3 replicas added, 20% traffic routed to eu-west, taints applied, logs collected and hardware ticket opened. monitoring closely.
charlie: leaving node taint in place until HW confirms. I'll uncordon after green checks.
samira: thanks all. I'll change incident state to monitoring once backend error rate drops under 1% for 10m. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (partial). severity downgraded to P2. monitoring for 3h.
